display.purpose: Section identity. One per screen. Always Orbitron, always uppercase, always tracked.

headline.purpose: Sub-section labels and panel headers. Orbitron medium.

title.purpose: Song titles in now-playing. Space Grotesk semibold.

body.purpose: Metadata, artist names, secondary labels. Space Grotesk regular.

label.purpose: Filter pills, timestamps, control labels. Space Grotesk medium, slightly tracked.

shadows.name: glass-panel
shadows.purpose: Floating panels: settings, queue, overlays. 3-layer: ambient dark + violet glow + inner border.

shadows.name: song-tile-hover
shadows.purpose: Song tile hover state. Paired with violet border shift.

shadows.name: album-art
shadows.purpose: Album art in now-playing overlay. Deep directional grounding.

shadows.name: magnetic-hover
shadows.purpose: Interactive thumbnail hover. Glow radius driven by --glow-softness.

shadows.name: glow-pulse
shadows.purpose: Pulsing animation on active playback indicator. 2.2s ease-in-out loop.

motion.name: aurora-float
motion.purpose: Aurora blob drift. translate3d + scale. Disabled by prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button. Violet-tinted glass border; the border glows before the fill floods.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgb(139 92 246 / 0.68); background: rgb(139 92 246 / 0.14); color: #ede9fe; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: rgb(167 139 250 / 0.85); background: rgb(139 92 246 / 0.24); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(139 92 246 / 0.8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Low-hierarchy action. Near-invisible at rest; border brightens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03); color: #e5e7eb; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.40); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(139 92 246 / 0.8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Search field. Translucent at rest; violet glow ring on focus. / key focuses it.
components.css: .ds-input-wrapper { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-input-icon { position: absolute; left: 10px; color: #6b7280; pointer-events: none; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px 8px 30px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); color: #f3f4f6; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7280; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: rgb(139 92 246 / 0.55); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(139 92 246 / 0.22); }

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: Filter tag. Used for song list filters (All, Loved, Recently Played). Fully rounded.
components.css: .ds-pill-group { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); color: #f3f4f6; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.30); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.09); } .ds-pill--active { border-color: rgb(139 92 246 / 0.60); background: rgb(139 92 246 / 0.12); color: #ede9fe; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(139 92 246 / 0.8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Song Tile
components.description: Individual song row. Flat at rest; violet border glow on hover. Currently playing state has persistent border.
components.html: Song TitleArtist · 3:42
components.css: .ds-song-tile { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-song-tile:hover { border-color: rgb(139 92 246 / 0.35); background: rgb(139 92 246 / 0.06); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgb(10 10 12 / 0.35); } .ds-song-tile__art { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: rgb(139 92 246 / 0.5); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-song-tile__info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; } .ds-song-tile__title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #f3f4f6; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-song-tile__meta { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; color: #6b7280; }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Floating panel surface. Used for settings, queue panel, modals. Backdrop blur + 3-layer shadow.
components.css: .ds-glass-panel { padding: 20px; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08), rgb(255 255 255 / 0.02)); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px); box-shadow: 0 12px 48px rgb(8 9 14 / 0.35), 0 0 36px rgb(139 92 246 / 0.14), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); } .ds-glass-panel__label { font-family: 'Orbitron', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f3f4f6; }

components.name: Upload Zone
components.description: Drag-and-drop file upload target. Violet accent activates on drag.
components.css: .ds-upload-zone { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; padding: 56px 32px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.10); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-upload-zone:hover { border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.20); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); } .ds-upload-zone__icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.15); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #6b7280; } .ds-upload-zone__text { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #d1d5db; } .ds-upload-zone__sub { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #6b7280; }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Orbitron section header. Used for screen titles and panel labels.
components.css: .ds-section-label { font-family: 'Orbitron', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f3f4f6; line-height: 1.2; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is an instrument room inside a private archive: surfaces barely present, light arriving only from the signal. Nothing decorates for decoration's sake. Violet is the frequency readout — the active marker, the focus ring, the border on the element asking for your attention. Cyan appears where the violet signal resonates, a harmonic overtone. The two colors together are not a palette choice; they are a physics fact about how those frequencies relate.

The system is dark because the listener is focused. Someone who has chosen to leave streaming platforms and upload their own files is not a casual user — they are deliberate. The interface matches that: no warm editorial surfaces, no "made for you" nudges, no rounded friendly shapes that imply a service is doing something for you. The library belongs to the user. The interface holds it without comment.

Glass surfaces appear only where they carry architectural meaning: the settings panel floating above content, the queue panel sliding in from outside the main surface, the now-playing overlay taking over the entire screen. Glass is structure, not decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Near-void base (#0c0c0e) with fractional white surfaces (2-8% opacity)
Violet as frequency marker; cyan as harmonic resonance — neither is used as fill color
Orbitron for structural labels and section identity; Space Grotesk for everything human
Glow expresses elevation and state before movement does
Aurora visualizer reacts to audio frequency data; all motion respects prefers-reduced-motion
Fully controllable: aurora intensity, glow softness, blur amount, accent color, theme

rules.name: The One Frequency Rule
rules.body: Violet appears as a solid color on ≤15% of any given screen. Its power comes from scarcity and glow spread. Reserve solid violet fills for active borders and primary button tints; let the glow radius do the visual work.

rules.name: The Tonal Void Rule
rules.body: The base is #0c0c0e, not #000000. Never render pure black or pure white. Every neutral carries the archive's cold undertone.

rules.name: The Harmonic Pair Rule
rules.body: Cyan appears only alongside violet, never alone. It is an overtone, not a second accent. If violet is absent from a surface, cyan must be absent too.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Orbitron speaks for the archive's structure. Space Grotesk speaks for the music and the user. They do not cross over.

rules.name: The Uppercase Contract
rules.body: Orbitron is always uppercase with letter-spacing ≥ 0.12em. Lowercase Orbitron breaks the typographic logic of the system entirely.

rules.name: The Glow-as-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Depth is glow, not darkness. Black shadows exist for ambient grounding; violet glow communicates interactive state and surface hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Every interactive surface is flat at rest. Glow and border shift appear only as state responses (hover, focus, active, playing). Static glow on a non-interactive surface is prohibited.

dos: Do use violet as glow and frequency marker. Let glow spread do the visual work, not solid fills.
Do use Orbitron uppercase with ≥ 0.12em letter-spacing for section headers and structural labels.
Do apply glass (backdrop-filter: blur(18px)) only on panels that architecturally float above the content plane.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion. Every aurora blob, parallax card, and magnetic hover must have a static fallback.
Do keep all easing exponential ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) or equivalent.
Do use rgb(var(--accent-rgb) / opacity) for any new interactive state that needs a violet glow.
donts: Don't add warm editorial card layouts, rounded organic shapes, or For You / discovery sections.
Don't add any content curation affordance: trending rows, recommended playlists, algorithmic suggestions.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient). Emphasis through weight or color, never gradient decoration.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe accent on list items or song tiles.
Don't use violet as a large fill color. If a surface is predominantly violet, the frequency metaphor collapses.
Don't introduce bounce or elastic easing. The archive is precise; it does not wobble.
Don't apply glassmorphism decoratively. Every backdrop-filter must have an architectural reason.
Don't replicate Apple Music's editorial warmth: large editorial images, serif type, warm neutral backgrounds.
Don't use the hero-metric template: large number, small label, supporting stats, gradient accent.
